content:
alex: Heads-up — after the kernel selector change last night we're seeing a 7-12ms median increase on host-side token preflight for short requests (:50-200 tokens). Looks like parsing + small frame writes are the culprit.

perf-bot: automated alert: host-ingress.latency p50 +9ms, p95 +22ms; spike correlates with deploy 8f3b2d7.

maria: copying quick flame: top symbols are 1) proto_unmarshal 2) token_preflight 3) grpcWritevSmallWrites 4) kvcache.lookup (hot). proto_unmarshal time jumped ~40%.

ryan: kvcache thrash makes sense — selector now picks model variants with slightly different seq-len heuristics, churns cache keys. Could be extra serializations happening during preflight.

samir: can we try disabling the new selector for the canary subset? Also propose tweak to batching heuristic to prefer model var that preserves cache key shape. quick patch: 
```json
{
  "batching": { "prefer_stable_kv_key": true, "min_batch_ms": 2 }
}
```

elaine: FYI grpc smallwrites coalescing regressed in the same commit (we changed write loop). Toggling `writev_coalesce=true` in the proxy reduced 50th by ~6ms in my local run. Suggest canary: proxy toggle + selector rollback.

alex: @samir @elaine can you both run a 30m canary with 10% traffic: selector rollback vs proxy toggle? capture p50/p95, CPU, writev counts, and a perf record on the host process. Include `pprof` cpu profile.

samir: starting canaries now — rolling one AZ, 10% each. instrumented with `perf record -F 99 -g -- ./host-runtime` and `pprof -http=:6060 ./host-runtime cpu` after 30m.

maria: added a tiny parsing micro-optim: avoid duplicate proto copy in preflight (inline buffer decode). Bench locally: short requests p50 -4ms, allocations down 22%. Pushed branch `maria/preflight-inline-try`.

ryan: note — if kvcache keys change due to model var selection, even the inline parse gains are masked. We should stabilise key schema first. I can add a small flag to opt into old key format for the canary.

elaine: results after 30m: proxy toggle reduced p50 by 6ms, selector rollback reduced p50 by 9ms; combined they bring p50 within baseline. p95 still +8ms. Attached mini traces (link: https://perf.internal/trace/804322). :eyes:

alex: great. next actions: 1) merge `maria/preflight-inline-try` behind feature flag, 2) revert selector change for wider rollout, 3) keep proxy coalesce toggle until we rework write loop, 4) follow-up to stabilise KV key shape. I'll file a follow-up triage and assign owners. :shipit:

perf-bot: ticket created: PERF-1829 "host preflight/regression triage — kernel selector + writev" assigned to alex/samir/maria.
